acceptance_scope: Matched console gameplay acceptance with installed artifact hashes and SD report snapshots
verification_limits: Gameplay observations and dispatch timing snapshots do not establish instrumented game-wide FPS, isolated CPU usage or physical peak RAM.
This session used six resident NROs; eight-resident and sixteen-script capacity checks have local ARM64 coverage, separate from this console session.
USB keyboard compatibility is optional and is not a Switch release requirement.
Asset conversion outputs and unrelated third-party mods require their own gameplay tests.
Earlier SDK Parity acceptance retains its separate restart, pointer, enumeration and controller coverage.
